title: Folders
description: `{ path, name, found, boards?, parent?, folders, recent, places?, more? }`: one folder under the home folder, whether it has a Vision Board, the folders in it, the folders opened lately and, on the home folder's listing, the cloud storage folders. Folder names only, never a file's name or contents.

found.description: True when this folder has a Vision Board: open it with open_project; else create one there with `create: true`.

boards.description: How many boards its ledger holds; given only when `found` is true.

parent.description: The folder above, left out for the home folder itself.

folders.description: The folders in it, by name; hidden folders (a name starting with a dot), `node_modules` and links are left out.

recent.description: The folders opened lately, newest first, each still there and under the home folder; `name` is its display name.

places.description: The cloud storage folders (the folders in `~/Library/CloudStorage`, where macOS keeps Dropbox and the like), by name; given only on the home folder's listing and only when that folder exists. Each is a real folder (not a link) that passes the same checks as `path`; one that does not is left out. `name` is its own name and `path` its real path, so browsing it goes on under the real names.

more.description: Present when the folder holds more folders than `folders` lists.
